tickets.title: Move hud-mcp sources under src/mcp, one TS project
tickets.what: Proposal docs/neon-proposal/03-build-dedup-and-clean-dist.md Slice 1 (:283-312): git mv packages/hud-mcp/src/*.ts to src/mcp, rewrite bin/extension/test/doc paths, drop packages/hud-mcp/tsconfig.json and its dist. Owner defaults taken: Q2 keep build:hud-mcp as an alias, Q3 hint on build before removing the old dist.

acceptance.text: One tsc build emits dist/mcp/*; packages/hud-mcp/dist is no longer produced
./install --skip-build, hud-mcp, worker tools and the pi extension load from the new paths
npm test, test:release and check:fixtures pass

tickets.title: Staged atomic build with orphan prune
tickets.what: Slice 2 (:314-327): scripts/build.mjs compiles into a stage dir and renames per file, prunes orphans, keeps dist intact on a failed compile; build/build:test/clean scripts; the panel reloads only when non-mcp files change.

acceptance.text: A failed compile leaves dist untouched; a successful one never blanks it

tickets.title: Tests import dist, dist-test shrinks
tickets.what: Slice 3 (:329-335) with owner default Q1 = 1A (declaration:true, dedupe build:test): .mjs and .ts tests import ../../dist; tsconfig.test.json includes only the TS test files.

acceptance.text: npm test passes from a clean checkout

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: (imp ja564dec47ff76916): 40 files, path rewrites + tsconfig.test.json rooted at tests/; dist-test 524 → 40 files, no dist-test/src; build:test needs build's dist/*.d.ts (npm test already orders build → build:test). Clean-clone run green. Main: 973/973 twice, unit 92, check:fixtures, test:release green. Two load flakes seen during integration fixed in tests.

tickets.title: A process starting during a build never loads a mix of old and new modules
tickets.what: Seen live 2026-11-22 08:55: an oracle's hud_sonic call failed with "The requested module '../collectors/thin-jobs.js' does not provide an export named 'jobRowReportMeta'" because it started while scripts/build.mjs was publishing REPORT-SUMMARY-03 file by file (new dist/mcp/thin-main.js, old dist/collectors/thin-jobs.js). BUILD-DEDUP-02 made each file atomic, not the tree. Fix with the smallest mechanism: e.g. scripts/build.mjs marks a publish window (the existing lock or a marker file) and the node entry points that spawn fresh processes (packages/hud-mcp/bin/*.mjs, bin/hud, the panel reload) wait briefly for it to clear before importing dist; or publish in an order that keeps imports satisfiable. No symlink tree switch (rejected in 02), no resident process.

acceptance.text: A test that starts an entry point while a publish is in progress never sees a missing-export error
Publish time and normal start time unchanged when no build runs; npm test passes

comments.author: main
comments.text: landed 03da36da (import conflict in panel-reload.ts with MONITOR-STATE-03 merged by hand). Startup imports and dist publication share a checkout-scoped abstract-socket lock (bounded 15 s); idle start +1–3 ms. Suite 946/946, test:release green in a clean worktree.
